# Test the chrome around a documented page: skip link, navigation
# toggle, table of contents, and the search affordance.

cd site

md2html -http :8097 -nav &
wait-port :8097

curl -s http://localhost:8097/guide

# Keyboard users get a way past the navigation
stdout 'class="skip-link" href="#main-content"'
stdout 'id="main-content"'

# The sidebar is addressable by the toggle that opens it on a narrow window
stdout 'class="nav-toggle" aria-controls="site-sidebar" aria-expanded="false"'
stdout 'id="site-sidebar"'

# Without -search there is nothing to click for search
! stdout 'class="search-trigger"'

-- site/SUMMARY.md --
# Summary

## Guides

* [Guide](guide.md)
* [Other](other.md)

-- site/guide.md --
# Guide

A page with enough headings to earn a table of contents.
